title: lint: RLS_PREDICATE_UNENFORCEABLE walks only permissions[].rowLevelSecurity, so an ObjectSchema.defaultRowScope whose using cannot lower is caught only at runtime
body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): an authoring-time check that does not see metadata the runtime now honours. Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`, from #24340's dev report (PR #24451). The first rider on #24340 (`6255162631`, `domain:spec` seat 2) asked that card's reader either to extend the lint or to name why the runtime refusal suffices. PR #24451 took the runtime route and named why, so this card carries the lint half. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's. The files are `packages/lint`'s (`domain:spec` by the lane table).

- **`reach:`** an author who declares `ObjectSchema.defaultRowScope` (#24338) with a `using` that cannot lower to a filter.
  - The authoring-time lint (`RLS_PREDICATE_UNENFORCEABLE`, `packages/lint/src/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability*.ts`) walks only `permissions[].rowLevelSecurity`, so it says nothing.
  - Once PR #24451 lands, `collectRLSPolicies` applies the default. A non-lowering `using` then fails closed at runtime with the same WARN and `RLS_DENY_FILTER` an authored policy's does, and that refusal is pinned there.
  - So the author learns of it only when rows disappear at runtime.
- **The same boundary on a second rule:** `validate-org-axis-red-lines`' rule ① also walks permission-set RLS only. A `defaultRowScope.using` that walks the org parent is not judged there either (PR #24451's Acceptance notes).

## Why it was not done in PR #24451

Extending the lint needs `RLS_PREDICATE_UNENFORCEABLE`'s entry in `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` reworded. Its shared `RLS_DROPPED_USING` paragraph says the object "disappears for every holder of the permission set", which is not the default's case. That file has an in-flight holder, #23566 (its own two rules' entries). **Serial note:** this card follows #23566's landing, or that file's release by its seat.

## Wanted

- `RLS_PREDICATE_UNENFORCEABLE` judges `ObjectSchema.defaultRowScope.using` (and `check`) as it judges a permission set's policy, with its explanation entry worded for both sources.
- Rule ① of `validate-org-axis-red-lines` judges the default too, or says why it need not.
- Pins: a default whose `using` does not lower is reported at authoring time. Control: a lowering default is not.

## Dedupe

The parent rider is `6255162631` on #24340. No open card covers the lint half: the predicate lint's own cards are closed, and #23566 is a different rule (translation references).

Dedupe words: defaultRowScope lint RLS_PREDICATE_UNENFORCEABLE; object default row scope using authoring time; validate-rls-predicate-enforceability defaultRowScope.
